This notebook analyzes cardiac phase organization from saved cell phases.
Whole-transcriptome gene fitting, modules, OVR, and phase refitting are optional
Appendix A steps. Panel labels below follow the analysis notebook; consult the
manuscript legends for the final layout.

Global `eval = FALSE` is retained. Configure the paths, then run the required
chunks manually in order. Optional model-fitting chunks have explicit switches.

| Panel | Required input | Requires infer_gene_param? |
|---|---|---|
| E | Saved cell phases + celltype/Group metadata | No |
| F | Saved cell phases + normalized RNA + legacy clock-gene set + CellAlign | No |
| G | Saved phases + metadata, followed by phase-profile DTW | No |
| H | Saved phases + celltype/Group/Sample metadata, followed by rho | No |
| I (deferred) | Gene parameters + modules for the old curve design | Yes, only if this design is retained |

There are only two observed sampling times (ZT08/ZT16). The figure describes
model-inferred phase organization; it is not independent validation of a
24-hour rhythm or recovery of missing sampling times. GEO GSE270258 defines
AM (06:00--10:00) and PM (14:00--18:00) windows in 16 different patients;
ZT08/ZT16 are representative window labels, not precise observed times. Statistics and significance annotations must be calculated from the selected analysis results.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  eval = FALSE,
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  fig.retina = 2
)
```

# 2. Load data and validate the verified schema

## 2.1 Optional full original object

The default Seurat v5 library stays first; the legacy library is appended only
to provide missing CellAlign/DTW dependencies. In v4, the `layer` argument can
be ignored, so silently falling back to v4 is not permitted here.

The object was inspected before this Rmd was written. It is a Seurat object with
24,386 genes, 127,942 cells, one `RNA` assay, and `counts`, `data`, and
`scale.data` layers. The following assertions deliberately fail if the source
object changes.

```{r heart_load_validate}
heart <- qs::qread(heart_data_file)
stopifnot(inherits(heart, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(identical(Seurat::Assays(heart), "RNA"))
Seurat::DefaultAssay(heart) <- "RNA"

heart_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(heart[["RNA"]])
stopifnot(all(c("counts", "data", "scale.data") %in% heart_layers))

heart_count <- SeuratObject::GetAssayData(heart, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
heart_data <- SeuratObject::GetAssayData(heart, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
heart_meta <- heart@meta.data
heart_meta <- heart_meta[colnames(heart_count), , drop = FALSE]
heart_meta$cell <- rownames(heart_meta)

heart_expected_meta <- c(
  "orig.ident", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", "Group", "Sample",
  "replicate", "Period", "ZT", "percent.mt", "RNA_snn_res.0.5",
  "seurat_clusters", "celltype"
)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(heart@meta.data), heart_expected_meta))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(heart_count), heart_meta$cell))
stopifnot(nrow(heart_count) == 24386L, ncol(heart_count) == 127942L)

heart_celltype_levels <- c(
  "Cardiomyocytes", "Endothelial", "Lymphocytes", "Myeloid", "Adipocytes",
  "Neuron", "Pericytes", "SMC", "Fibroblasts", "Myofibroblasts"
)
stopifnot(setequal(unique(as.character(heart_meta$celltype)), heart_celltype_levels))
stopifnot(setequal(unique(as.character(heart_meta$Group)), c("NCR", "ACR")))
stopifnot(setequal(unique(as.character(heart_meta$ZT)), c("ZT08", "ZT16")))
stopifnot(length(unique(as.character(heart_meta$Sample))) == 16L)

heart_meta$Group <- factor(as.character(heart_meta$Group), levels = c("NCR", "ACR"))
heart_meta$celltype <- factor(as.character(heart_meta$celltype), levels = heart_celltype_levels)
heart_meta$ZT_num <- as.numeric(sub("^ZT", "", as.character(heart_meta$ZT)))

heart_sample_design <- heart_meta |>
  dplyr::distinct(.data$Group, .data$Sample, .data$replicate, .data$ZT, .data$ZT_num) |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$Group, .data$ZT_num, .data$Sample)

stopifnot(nrow(heart_sample_design) == 16L)
stopifnot(all(table(heart_sample_design$Group, heart_sample_design$ZT) == 4L))

readr::write_tsv(
  heart_sample_design,
  file.path(heart_root, "verified_sample_design.tsv")
)
```

## 2.2 Lightweight plotting input (used for this completed run)

Use this chunk instead of reloading the full object when the prepared input
exists. It retains all 127,942 cells and the 27 prespecified clock genes, read
from the original per-celltype RNA data layers. Metadata fields, sample labels,
and cell IDs were checked against the source schema and current phase cache.
It is not a whole-transcriptome count matrix; Appendix A still requires 2.1.

```{r heart_load_plot_inputs}
heart_plot_inputs <- readRDS(heart_plot_input_file)
heart_meta <- heart_plot_inputs$metadata
heart_data <- heart_plot_inputs$clock_expression
heart_celltype_levels <- heart_plot_inputs$celltype_levels
stopifnot(identical(heart_meta$cell, colnames(heart_data)))
stopifnot(nrow(heart_meta) == 127942L, heart_plot_inputs$RNA_features == 24386L)
stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(heart_phase_file)), heart_plot_inputs$phase_md5))
stopifnot(all(c("cell", "celltype", "Group", "Sample", "ZT", "ZT_num") %in% names(heart_meta)))
```

# 3. Phase-first analysis: no gene-level fitting

Run Sections 1--3, then the E/F/G/H chunks. Do not run Appendix A for these
panels. The saved phase result is read, not recomputed. E itself does not need
rho; rho is used only for H/S11B. Rho and DTW are calculated directly in
separate chunks; no automatic cache branches are used. F also uses normalized RNA expression of the
small legacy seed-gene set, but not gene-parameter or module inference.

## 3.1 Load and validate the saved cell phase

```{r heart_load_saved_phase}
stopifnot(file.exists(heart_phase_file))
res_phase_heart <- readRDS(heart_phase_file)
stopifnot(is.data.frame(res_phase_heart))
stopifnot(all(c("cell", "theta_pred", "r_cell", "stratum") %in% names(res_phase_heart)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase_heart$cell))
stopifnot(setequal(res_phase_heart$cell, heart_meta$cell))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(res_phase_heart$theta_pred)))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(res_phase_heart$r_cell)))
stopifnot(all(
  as.character(res_phase_heart$stratum) ==
    as.character(heart_meta[res_phase_heart$cell, "celltype"])
))

heart_theta <- stats::setNames(res_phase_heart$theta_pred, res_phase_heart$cell)
heart_r_cell <- stats::setNames(res_phase_heart$r_cell, res_phase_heart$cell)
heart_phase_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(heart_phase_file))
```

## 3.2 Calculate sample-level rho directly

```{r heart_run_phase_rho}
res_rho_heart <- run_phase_rho(
  res_phase = res_phase_heart,
  metadata = heart_meta,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "Group",
  sample_by = "Sample",
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  celltype_levels = heart_celltype_levels,
  group_levels = c("NCR", "ACR"),
  compare_groups = c("NCR", "ACR"),
  min_cell = 10,
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  Verbose = TRUE
)

saveRDS(res_rho_heart, heart_rho_file)
readr::write_tsv(res_rho_heart$rho_sample, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "heart_rho_sample.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(res_rho_heart$sig_result, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "heart_rho_statistics.tsv"))
res_rho_heart <- readRDS(heart_rho_file)
stopifnot(all(c("data", "rho_sample", "sig_result") %in% names(res_rho_heart)))
stopifnot(setequal(res_rho_heart$data$cell, res_phase_heart$cell))
stopifnot(all(as.character(res_rho_heart$data$Group) == as.character(heart_meta[res_rho_heart$data$cell, "Group"])))
stopifnot(all(as.character(res_rho_heart$data$Sample) == as.character(heart_meta[res_rho_heart$data$cell, "Sample"])))
stopifnot(all(as.character(res_rho_heart$data$cell_type) == as.character(heart_meta[res_rho_heart$data$cell, "celltype"])))
stopifnot(all(abs(atan2(
  sin(res_rho_heart$data$theta - heart_theta[res_rho_heart$data$cell]),
  cos(res_rho_heart$data$theta - heart_theta[res_rho_heart$data$cell])
)) < 1e-8))
```

## 3.3 Calculate phase-distribution DTW directly

```{r heart_run_dtw_similarity}
res_dtw_heart <- run_dtw_similarity(
  res_phase = res_phase_heart,
  metadata = heart_meta,
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "Group",
  group_levels = c("NCR", "ACR"),
  celltype_levels = heart_celltype_levels,
  n_bin = 24,
  min_cell = 10,
  normalize_distance = TRUE,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

saveRDS(res_dtw_heart, heart_dtw_file)
readr::write_tsv(
  tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(res_dtw_heart$similarity), "profile"),
  file.path(heart_figure_dir, "heart_dtw_similarity.tsv")
)
res_dtw_heart <- readRDS(heart_dtw_file)
stopifnot(all(c("data", "similarity", "annotation") %in% names(res_dtw_heart)))
stopifnot(identical(dim(res_dtw_heart$similarity), c(20L, 20L)))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(res_dtw_heart$similarity)))
stopifnot(setequal(res_dtw_heart$data$cell, res_phase_heart$cell))
stopifnot(all(as.character(res_dtw_heart$data$Group) == as.character(heart_meta[res_dtw_heart$data$cell, "Group"])))
stopifnot(all(as.character(res_dtw_heart$data$cell_type) == as.character(heart_meta[res_dtw_heart$data$cell, "celltype"])))
stopifnot(all(abs(atan2(
  sin(res_dtw_heart$data$phase_rad - heart_theta[res_dtw_heart$data$cell]),
  cos(res_dtw_heart$data$phase_rad - heart_theta[res_dtw_heart$data$cell])
)) < 1e-8))
```

```{r heart_figure_settings}
heart_group_cols <- c("NCR" = "#D7E8F0", "ACR" = "#E9D5E3")
heart_group_line_cols <- c("NCR" = "#5F8EA3", "ACR" = "#A17494")
heart_zt_cols <- c("ZT08" = "#D7E8F0", "ZT16" = "#E9D5E3")

  "Lymphocytes" = "#00A087", "Myeloid" = "#3C5488",
  "Adipocytes" = "#F39B7F", "Neuron" = "#8491B4",

)

heart_phase_labels <- c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π")

grDevices::pdfFonts(Arial = grDevices::pdfFonts("ArialMT")[[1]])

heart_save_svg <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {

  grDevices::dev.off()

heart_save_tiff <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {
  ragg::agg_tiff(
    filename, width = width, height = height, units = "in",
    res = 600, compression = "lzw"
  )
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
```

# 5. Main Figure E: cell-phase ridgeline

```{r heart_main_E}
res_phase_heart <- readRDS(heart_phase_file)
heart_phase_plot <- res_phase_heart |>
  dplyr::select("cell", "theta_pred") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    heart_meta |> dplyr::select("cell", "celltype", "Group"),
    by = "cell"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta_pred = .data$theta_pred %% (2 * pi),
    Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR"))
  )
stopifnot(nrow(heart_phase_plot) == nrow(res_phase_heart))
stopifnot(!anyNA(heart_phase_plot))

# Legacy E ordering: pooled, condition-wise rho; independent of the H cache.
heart_celltype_rho_order <- heart_phase_plot |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$celltype, .data$Group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rho = sqrt(mean(cos(.data$theta_pred))^2 + mean(sin(.data$theta_pred))^2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$celltype) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_rho = mean(.data$rho), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$mean_rho)) |>
  dplyr::pull(.data$celltype) |>
  as.character()

heart_E_density_groups <- heart_phase_plot |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$celltype, .data$Group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(theta_list = list(.data$theta_pred), n_cells = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

heart_E_density <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(heart_E_density_groups)), function(i) {
  theta <- heart_E_density_groups$theta_list[[i]]
  den <- stats::density(
    c(theta - 2 * pi, theta, theta + 2 * pi),
    from = 0, to = 2 * pi, n = 720, bw = 0.35
  )
  tibble::tibble(
    celltype = as.character(heart_E_density_groups$celltype[i]),
    Group = as.character(heart_E_density_groups$Group[i]),
    theta = den$x, density = den$y,
    n_cells = heart_E_density_groups$n_cells[i]
  )
}))
heart_E_ridge_levels <- rev(as.vector(t(outer(
  heart_celltype_rho_order, c("NCR", "ACR"), paste, sep = " | "
))))
heart_E_density$ridge_id <- factor(
  paste(heart_E_density$celltype, heart_E_density$Group, sep = " | "),
  levels = heart_E_ridge_levels
)
heart_E_density$Group <- factor(heart_E_density$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR"))

heart_E_blocks <- tibble::tibble(celltype = heart_celltype_rho_order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    idx_ncr = match(paste(.data$celltype, "NCR", sep = " | "), heart_E_ridge_levels),
    idx_acr = match(paste(.data$celltype, "ACR", sep = " | "), heart_E_ridge_levels),
    ymin = pmin(.data$idx_ncr, .data$idx_acr) - 0.48,
    ymax = pmax(.data$idx_ncr, .data$idx_acr) + 0.48,
    xmin = -0.78 * pi, xmax = -0.06 * pi
  )
heart_E_block_cols <- c(
  "#F6EDEE", "#EAF1F6", "#EAF5F1", "#F3EFF8", "#F7F1EA",
  "#EEF3F8", "#EDF6F2", "#F7F2E8", "#EEF0F7", "#F4EEF5"
)

p_main_E <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  heart_E_density,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$theta, y = .data$ridge_id,
    height = .data$density, group = .data$ridge_id, fill = .data$Group
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = heart_E_blocks,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = .data$xmin, xmax = .data$xmax, ymin = .data$ymin, ymax = .data$ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = heart_E_block_cols, color = NA
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = heart_E_blocks,
    ggplot2::aes(x = (.data$xmin + .data$xmax) / 2, y = (.data$ymin + .data$ymax) / 2,
                 label = .data$celltype),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggridges::geom_ridgeline(
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.95, scale = 10, min_height = 0
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_group_cols, breaks = c("NCR", "ACR")) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.84 * pi, 2 * pi), breaks = heart_phase_breaks,
    labels = heart_phase_labels, expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Cell Phase Distribution", x = "Predicted phase θ", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = heart_base_family) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

readr::write_tsv(heart_phase_plot, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_E_cell_phases.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(heart_E_density, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_E_circular_density.tsv"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_E_phase_ridgeline.pdf"), p_main_E, width = 4.8, height = 4.6, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_E_phase_ridgeline.png"), p_main_E, width = 4.8, height = 4.6, dpi = 600)
heart_save_svg(p_main_E, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_E_phase_ridgeline.svg"), 4.8, 4.6)
```

# 6. Main Figure F: CellAlign local dissimilarity heatmaps

The current `run_dtw_similarity()` output is used for panel G. F is different:
it aligns normalized clock-gene expression along inferred phase, not phase
histograms alone. It does NOT require `infer_gene_param()`, modules, or OVR.
The legacy 30-point interpolation and 20 permutations are retained. This is
structural reuse with the new phases and repaired seed symbols, not a claim of
numerical identity with the old screenshot.

```{r heart_main_F_cellalign}
sub2ind <- cellAlign::sub2ind
source(heart_plotalign_file)

heart_seed_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
heart_seed_objects <- load(heart_seed_file, envir = heart_seed_env)
heart_seed_genes <- unique(toupper(as.character(unlist(
  mget(heart_seed_objects, envir = heart_seed_env),
  use.names = FALSE
))))
heart_seed_genes[heart_seed_genes == "BMAL1"] <- "ARNTL"
heart_seed_genes <- intersect(heart_seed_genes, rownames(heart_data))
readr::write_tsv(
  tibble::tibble(gene = heart_seed_genes),
  file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_F_seed_genes.tsv")
)
stopifnot(length(heart_seed_genes) >= 20L)

heart_cellalign_order <- c(
  "Cardiomyocytes", "Endothelial", "Lymphocytes", "Myeloid", "Adipocytes",
  "Neuron", "Pericytes", "SMC", "Fibroblasts", "Myofibroblasts"
)
heart_cellalign_dir <- file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_F_CellAlign")
set.seed(1)
dir.create(heart_cellalign_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
heart_alignment_panels <- vector("list", length(heart_cellalign_order))
names(heart_alignment_panels) <- heart_cellalign_order

for (heart_ct in heart_cellalign_order) {
  heart_alignment_file <- file.path(heart_cellalign_dir, paste0("Alignment_", heart_ct, ".rds"))
  heart_cells_ct <- heart_meta$cell[heart_meta$celltype == heart_ct]
  heart_meta_ct <- heart_meta[heart_cells_ct, , drop = FALSE]
  heart_meta_ct$theta_pred <- heart_theta[heart_cells_ct] %% (2 * pi)
  heart_expr_ct <- heart_data[heart_seed_genes, heart_cells_ct, drop = FALSE]

  heart_ncr_cells <- heart_meta_ct$cell[heart_meta_ct$Group == "NCR"]
  heart_acr_cells <- heart_meta_ct$cell[heart_meta_ct$Group == "ACR"]

  heart_ncr_inter <- cellAlign::interWeights(
    expDataBatch = as.matrix(heart_expr_ct[, heart_ncr_cells, drop = FALSE]),
    trajCond = heart_meta_ct[heart_ncr_cells, "theta_pred"],
    winSz = 0.1,
    numPts = 30
  )
  heart_acr_inter <- cellAlign::interWeights(
    expDataBatch = as.matrix(heart_expr_ct[, heart_acr_cells, drop = FALSE]),
    trajCond = heart_meta_ct[heart_acr_cells, "theta_pred"],
    winSz = 0.1,
    numPts = 30
  )

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(heart_ncr_inter$interpolatedVals)))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(heart_acr_inter$interpolatedVals)))
  heart_F_variable <- heart_seed_genes[
    apply(heart_ncr_inter$interpolatedVals, 1, function(x) diff(range(x))) > 1e-12 &
      apply(heart_acr_inter$interpolatedVals, 1, function(x) diff(range(x))) > 1e-12
  ]
  readr::write_tsv(
    tibble::tibble(gene = heart_seed_genes, used = heart_seed_genes %in% heart_F_variable),
    file.path(heart_cellalign_dir, paste0("Seed_gene_QC_", heart_ct, ".tsv"))
  )
  stopifnot(length(heart_F_variable) >= 3L)
  heart_ncr_scaled <- cellAlign::scaleInterpolate(heart_ncr_inter)
  heart_acr_scaled <- cellAlign::scaleInterpolate(heart_acr_inter)
  heart_alignment <- cellAlign::globalAlign(
    x = heart_acr_scaled$scaledData[heart_F_variable, , drop = FALSE],
    y = heart_ncr_scaled$scaledData[heart_F_variable, , drop = FALSE],
    scores = list(query = heart_acr_scaled$traj, ref = heart_ncr_scaled$traj),
    sigCalc = TRUE,
    numPerm = 20
  )

  attr(heart_alignment, "heart_phase_md5") <- heart_phase_md5
  attr(heart_alignment, "heart_seed_genes") <- heart_F_variable
  saveRDS(heart_alignment, heart_alignment_file)
  heart_cost <- heart_alignment$localCostMatrix
  heart_path <- heart_alignment$align[[1]]
  heart_cost[cbind(heart_path$index1, heart_path$index2)] <- NA_real_
  heart_cost_data <- expand.grid(ACR = seq_len(nrow(heart_cost)), NCR = seq_len(ncol(heart_cost)))
  heart_cost_data$cost <- as.vector(heart_cost)
  stopifnot(all(is.na(heart_cost_data$cost) | (heart_cost_data$cost >= 0 & heart_cost_data$cost <= 1)))
  readr::write_tsv(heart_cost_data, file.path(heart_cellalign_dir, paste0("Local_cost_", heart_ct, ".tsv")))
  heart_alignment_panels[[heart_ct]] <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    heart_cost_data, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$NCR, y = .data$ACR, fill = .data$cost)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_raster() +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = viridis::plasma(100), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1),
      na.value = "#BDBDBD", name = "Dissimilarity"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = heart_ct, x = "NCR", y = "ACR") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = heart_base_family) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.9, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.13, "cm"),
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(3, 1, 3, 1)
    )

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    file.path(heart_cellalign_dir, paste0("Dissimilarity_Heatmap_", heart_ct, ".pdf")),
    width = 4, height = 3
  )
  plotAlignCustom(alignment = heart_alignment, title = heart_ct)
  grDevices::dev.off()

  ragg::agg_png(
    file.path(heart_cellalign_dir, paste0("Dissimilarity_Heatmap_", heart_ct, ".png")),
    width = 4, height = 3, units = "in", res = 600
  )
  plotAlignCustom(alignment = heart_alignment, title = heart_ct)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

saveRDS(heart_alignment_panels, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_F_panel_objects.rds"))
```

# 8. Main Figure H and Supplementary Figure S11B: sample-level rho

Dots are biological samples, not individual cells. A donor × celltype with
fewer than 10 cells has rho recorded as NA by `run_phase_rho()`; this is an
analysis-quality threshold, not removal of that donor from the source data.
The exported count table records the actual usable n in each group. Stars
come from the current two-sided Wilcoxon tests with BH adjustment across cell
types, never from the reference image.


```{r heart_main_H_rho}
res_rho_heart <- readRDS(heart_rho_file)
heart_rho_sample <- res_rho_heart$rho_sample |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")),
    cell_type = factor(.data$cell_type, levels = heart_celltype_levels)
  )
heart_rho_n <- heart_rho_sample |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$cell_type, .data$Group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sample_total = dplyr::n(), n_sample_used = sum(is.finite(.data$rho)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
readr::write_tsv(heart_rho_n, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_H_sample_counts.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(heart_rho_sample, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_H_sample_rho.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(res_rho_heart$sig_result, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_H_statistics.tsv"))
heart_rho_plot <- heart_rho_sample |> dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$rho))
set.seed(1)
heart_rho_sig <- res_rho_heart$sig_result |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_type = factor(.data$cell_type, levels = heart_celltype_levels),
    y_pos = max(heart_rho_sample$rho, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.012
  )

p_main_H <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  heart_rho_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$cell_type, y = .data$rho, fill = .data$Group)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.62,
    outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(group = .data$Group),
    position = ggplot2::position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.72, seed = 1),
    size = 0.85, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = heart_rho_sig,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data$cell_type, y = .data$y_pos, label = .data$p_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.0, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_group_cols) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.02), labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.16))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "ρ (%)", fill = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = heart_base_family) +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_H_sample_rho.pdf"), p_main_H, width = 7.2, height = 3.5, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_H_sample_rho.png"), p_main_H, width = 7.2, height = 3.5, dpi = 600)
heart_save_svg(p_main_H, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Main_H_sample_rho.svg"), 7.2, 3.5)
```

# 9. Core-clock curve source used by Main I and S11C

Deferred: do not run Sections 9--10 or 12 until the I-panel design is agreed.
These chunks are gated by `heart_make_clock_panels <- FALSE`.

The module labels are taken from the newly fitted module result. A missing curve
is intentional for one-sided modules because `infer_rhythm_module()` masks the
non-rhythmic group parameters.

```{r heart_core_clock_curves, eval=FALSE}
stopifnot(isTRUE(heart_make_clock_panels))
heart_core_genes <- c(
  "ARNTL", "CLOCK", "CRY1", "CRY2", "DBP", "NFIL3", "NPAS2",
  "NR1D1", "NR1D2", "PER1", "PER2", "PER3", "TEF", "CIART"
)
heart_curve_dir <- file.path(heart_figure_dir, "Core_clock_curves")
dir.create(heart_curve_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

heart_curve_plot <- function(celltype_use, gene_use) {
  module_use <- readRDS(
    file.path(heart_module_dir, paste0(celltype_use, "_infer_rhythm_module.rds"))
  )$module_result |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$gene == gene_use)

  stopifnot(nrow(module_use) == 1L)

  param_use <- readRDS(
    file.path(heart_param_dir, paste0(celltype_use, "_infer_gene_param.rds"))
  )$param_wide |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$gene == gene_use)
  stopifnot(nrow(param_use) == 1L)
  phase_grid <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)

  curve_use <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble::tibble(
      Group = "NCR", phase = phase_grid,
      expression = param_use$Mean_NCR +
        module_use$Amplitude_NCR * cos(phase_grid - module_use$Phase_NCR)
    ),
    tibble::tibble(
      Group = "ACR", phase = phase_grid,
      expression = param_use$Mean_ACR +
        module_use$Amplitude_ACR * cos(phase_grid - module_use$Phase_ACR)
    )
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$expression)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")))

  ggplot2::ggplot(curve_use, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$phase, y = .data$expression, color = .data$Group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = heart_group_line_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = heart_phase_breaks, labels = heart_phase_labels) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = gene_use,
      subtitle = paste0("M", module_use$module_map),
      x = expression("Predicted phase " * phi),
      y = "Normalized Expression",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 7, base_family = heart_base_family) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 6),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6.5),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.28, "cm"),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5)
    )
}

heart_core_plot <- list()
for (heart_ct in heart_celltype_levels) {
  heart_core_plot[[heart_ct]] <- list()
  for (heart_gene in intersect(heart_core_genes, rownames(heart_data))) {
    heart_core_plot[[heart_ct]][[heart_gene]] <- heart_curve_plot(heart_ct, heart_gene)
  }
}
```

# 11. Supplementary Figure S11A: phase flowers by group

```{r heart_s11A_phase_flowers}
heart_phase_zt_plot <- res_phase_heart |>
  dplyr::select("cell", "theta_pred") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    heart_meta |> dplyr::select("cell", "celltype", "Group", "ZT_num"), by = "cell"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(theta_pred = .data$theta_pred %% (2 * pi))
stopifnot(nrow(heart_phase_zt_plot) == 127942L, !anyNA(heart_phase_zt_plot))

heart_flower_plots <- heart_flower_polygons <- heart_flower_source <- list()
heart_window_source <- tibble::tibble(
  ZT_group = c("ZT08", "ZT16"), window_start = c(6, 14), window_end = c(10, 18)
)
heart_ring_poly <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(2), function(i) {
  theta <- seq(heart_window_source$window_start[i], heart_window_source$window_end[i], length.out = 160) / 24 * 2 * pi
  tibble::tibble(
    theta = c(theta, rev(theta)), radius = c(rep(0.84, 160), rep(0.72, 160)),
    ZT_group = heart_window_source$ZT_group[i]
  )
})) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = .data$radius * sin(.data$theta), y = .data$radius * cos(.data$theta))
heart_guide <- tibble::tibble(theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 361)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = 1.68 * sin(.data$theta), y = 1.68 * cos(.data$theta))
heart_ticks <- tibble::tibble(hour = seq(0, 21, by = 3)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    theta = .data$hour / 24 * 2 * pi,
    x = 1.58 * sin(.data$theta), xend = 1.68 * sin(.data$theta),
    y = 1.58 * cos(.data$theta), yend = 1.68 * cos(.data$theta),
    label_x = 2.25 * sin(.data$theta), label_y = 2.25 * cos(.data$theta),
    lab = paste0(.data$hour, "h")
  )

for (heart_ct in heart_celltype_levels) {
  heart_ct_phase <- heart_phase_zt_plot |> dplyr::filter(.data$celltype == heart_ct)
  heart_curve_parts <- heart_poly_parts <- list()
  heart_k <- 1L
  for (heart_group in c("NCR", "ACR")) {
    for (heart_zt in c(8, 16)) {
      theta <- heart_ct_phase$theta_pred[
        heart_ct_phase$Group == heart_group & heart_ct_phase$ZT_num == heart_zt
      ]
      stopifnot(length(theta) >= 2L)
      den <- stats::density(
        c(theta - 2 * pi, theta, theta + 2 * pi), from = 0, to = 2 * pi, n = 720, bw = 0.35
      )
      radius <- 0.92 + 0.72 * den$y / max(den$y)
      heart_curve_parts[[heart_k]] <- tibble::tibble(
        celltype = heart_ct, Group = heart_group, ZT_group = sprintf("ZT%02d", heart_zt),
        theta = den$x, density = den$y, radius = radius
      )
      heart_poly_parts[[heart_k]] <- tibble::tibble(
        celltype = heart_ct, Group = heart_group, ZT_group = sprintf("ZT%02d", heart_zt),
        theta = c(den$x, rev(den$x)), radius = c(radius, rep(0.92, length(radius)))
      )
      heart_k <- heart_k + 1L
    }
  }
  heart_flower_source[[heart_ct]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(heart_curve_parts)
  heart_flower_polygons[[heart_ct]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(heart_poly_parts) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      x = .data$radius * sin(.data$theta), y = .data$radius * cos(.data$theta),
      Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR"))
    )
  heart_flower_n <- heart_ct_phase |>
    dplyr::count(.data$Group, name = "n_cells") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")),
      lab = paste0("n=", .data$n_cells)
    )

  heart_flower_plots[[heart_ct]] <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = heart_flower_polygons[[heart_ct]],
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y, fill = .data$ZT_group, group = .data$ZT_group),
      alpha = 0.45, color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = heart_ring_poly,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y, fill = .data$ZT_group, group = .data$ZT_group),
      alpha = 0.95, color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(
      data = heart_guide, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y),
      color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = heart_ticks,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, xend = .data$xend, y = .data$y, yend = .data$yend),
      color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = heart_ticks,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$label_x, y = .data$label_y, label = .data$lab),
      size = 2.0, color = "grey35"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = heart_flower_n, ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0.35, label = .data$lab),
      size = 1.85, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Group, nrow = 1) +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed(xlim = c(-2.75, 2.75), ylim = c(-2.75, 2.75), expand = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_zt_cols, name = "True ZT",
                              breaks = c("ZT08", "ZT16"), labels = c("ZT08", "ZT16")) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = heart_ct) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 7, base_family = heart_base_family) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 6),
      legend.position = "right", legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(3, 2, 3, 2)
    )
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(heart_figure_dir, paste0("S11_A_", heart_ct, "_phase_flower.pdf")),
    heart_flower_plots[[heart_ct]], width = 7, height = 4.3, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
  )
}

readr::write_tsv(dplyr::bind_rows(heart_flower_source), file.path(heart_figure_dir, "S11_A_density_source.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(heart_window_source, file.path(heart_figure_dir, "S11_A_sampling_windows.tsv"))
heart_s11A_grobs <- lapply(seq_along(heart_flower_plots), function(i) {
  grid::grobTree(ggplot2::ggplotGrob(heart_flower_plots[[i]]),
                vp = grid::viewport(name = paste0("heart_S11A_", i)))
})
heart_S11A_grid <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(grobs = heart_s11A_grobs, ncol = 5)
heart_S11A_ids <- paste0("p", seq_len(20))
heart_S11A_rows <- c(

  list(heart_S11A_ids[seq(1, 9, 2)], heart_S11A_ids[seq(2, 10, 2)],
       heart_S11A_ids[seq(11, 19, 2)], heart_S11A_ids[seq(12, 20, 2)])
)
measure_heart_panels(

)
grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(heart_figure_dir, "S11_A_phase_flowers.pdf"), width = 11, height = 5.5)

grDevices::dev.off()
```

# Appendix A. Optional expensive analysis -- NOT required for E--H

All chunks below are disabled and guarded. Keep `heart_refit_phase = FALSE`
and `heart_run_gene_level = FALSE` for the current phase-first task.
Existing per-celltype gene/module files are protected by assertions and are not overwritten. If a future
refit uses different phases or a different design, select a new `heart_root`;
do not mix old and new caches. No original source script is modified.

## A1. Optional phase refit (disabled)

Gene symbols in this object are human-style uppercase symbols, so the species is
set to `human` rather than inferred from the sample description.

The isolated phase-function repair handles the QR-identified aliased coefficient
in the initial two-ZT design. It preserves NB fitting and the Poisson-limit
fallback, and records each seed fit in the returned object's attributes.

```{r heart_infer_cell_phase, eval=FALSE}
stopifnot(isTRUE(heart_refit_phase))
stopifnot(!file.exists(heart_phase_file))
source(heart_phase_fix_file)
res_phase_heart <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = heart_count,
  metadata = heart_meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT_num",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "human",
  n_grid = 60,
  n_iter_outer = 5,
  n_iter_seed = 3,
  Kappa = 5,
  p_mix = 0.85,
  Min_n = 200,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE,
  min_seed = 0.01,
  family = "NB"
)

saveRDS(res_phase_heart, heart_phase_file)
readr::write_tsv(res_phase_heart, file.path(heart_root, "heart_infer_cell_phase.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(
  attr(res_phase_heart, "seed_fit_diagnostics"),
  file.path(heart_root, "heart_seed_fit_diagnostics.tsv")
)
```

## A2. Optional gene parameters (disabled; not needed for E--H)

Each group contains eight biological samples, with four samples at each ZT.
`Sample` is therefore the independent resampling unit and `ZT_num` is the
sample-bootstrap stratum.

```{r heart_infer_gene_param, eval=FALSE}
stopifnot(isTRUE(heart_run_gene_level))
source(file.path(heart_algo_dir, "infer_gene_param.R"))
res_phase_heart <- readRDS(heart_phase_file)
heart_theta <- stats::setNames(res_phase_heart$theta_pred, res_phase_heart$cell)
heart_r_cell <- stats::setNames(res_phase_heart$r_cell, res_phase_heart$cell)

heart_param <- vector("list", length(heart_celltype_levels))
names(heart_param) <- heart_celltype_levels

for (heart_ct in heart_celltype_levels) {
  heart_param_path <- file.path(heart_param_dir, paste0(heart_ct, "_infer_gene_param.rds"))
  stopifnot(!file.exists(heart_param_path))
  heart_cells_ct <- heart_meta$cell[heart_meta$celltype == heart_ct]
  heart_count_ct <- heart_count[, heart_cells_ct, drop = FALSE]
  heart_meta_ct <- heart_meta[heart_cells_ct, , drop = FALSE]

  heart_param[[heart_ct]] <- infer_gene_param(
    count = heart_count_ct,
    metadata = heart_meta_ct,
    theta_pred = heart_theta[heart_cells_ct],
    r_cell = heart_r_cell[heart_cells_ct],
    strata_by = "Group",
    ZT_by = "ZT_num",
    B = 100,
    n_worker = min(12L, max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 2L)),
    setseed = 1,
    Verbose = TRUE,
    sample_by = "Sample",
    sample_boot_by = "ZT_num"
  )

  saveRDS(
    heart_param[[heart_ct]],
    file.path(heart_param_dir, paste0(heart_ct, "_infer_gene_param.rds"))
  )
  readr::write_tsv(
    heart_param[[heart_ct]]$param_wide,
    file.path(heart_param_dir, paste0(heart_ct, "_param_wide.tsv"))
  )
}
```

## A3. Optional modules (disabled)

```{r heart_infer_rhythm_module, eval=FALSE}
stopifnot(isTRUE(heart_run_gene_level))
source(file.path(heart_algo_dir, "infer_rhythm_module.R"))
heart_module <- vector("list", length(heart_celltype_levels))
names(heart_module) <- heart_celltype_levels

for (heart_ct in heart_celltype_levels) {
  heart_module_path <- file.path(heart_module_dir, paste0(heart_ct, "_infer_rhythm_module.rds"))
  stopifnot(!file.exists(heart_module_path))
  heart_param_ct <- readRDS(
    file.path(heart_param_dir, paste0(heart_ct, "_infer_gene_param.rds"))
  )
  heart_module_out_ct <- file.path(heart_module_dir, heart_ct)
  dir.create(heart_module_out_ct, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  heart_module[[heart_ct]] <- infer_rhythm_module(
    param_wide = heart_param_ct$param_wide,
    compare_by = "Group",
    group1 = "NCR",
    group2 = "ACR",
    tau_q = 0.05,
    tau_A = 0.25,
    tau_dA = 1,
    tau_dphi = pi / 6,
    out_dir = heart_module_out_ct,
    Verbose = TRUE
  )

  saveRDS(
    heart_module[[heart_ct]],
    file.path(heart_module_dir, paste0(heart_ct, "_infer_rhythm_module.rds"))
  )
}
```

```{r heart_infer_ovr_rhythm, eval=FALSE}
)

saveRDS(res_ovr_heart, heart_ovr_file)
readr::write_tsv(res_ovr_heart$ovr_result, file.path(heart_root, "heart_ovr_result.tsv"))
```

# 14. Saved-result NCR/ACR cell-type ranking

This section reads the completed `run_phase_rho()` and
`run_dtw_similarity()` RDS objects only. It does not run phase inference, gene
inference, rho or DTW again.

Delta rho is defined as `mean rho(ACR) - mean rho(NCR)` using the group means
already stored in `rho_sample_summary`. The DTW value is the same-cell-type
NCR-versus-ACR raw normalized distance extracted from the saved `distance`
matrix with the saved `annotation`; heatmap similarity colours are not used as
effect sizes. Rank 1 is the largest absolute rho change or largest paired DTW
distance, and the descriptive combined order is the ascending sum of the two
ranks. Existing p values and BH FDR are retained from `sig_result`, do not enter
the ranking, and unavailable tests remain NA rather than being labelled `ns`.

```{r heart-saved-result-ranking-20261024, eval=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
source(
  "/path/to/scRhythmBayes/reproducibility/05_heart/scHeart_existing_results_ranking_20261024.R"
)
```

The ranking CSV and independent PNG/PDF scatter are written under
`/path/to/source_archive/new figures /figure6/existing_results_review_20261024`.
